system.description: Base Essence (Elemental Companion) 5.11.1 - Dark Mastery. Detecting shadows, seeing in the dark (Nightvision, Darkvision, Light Vision), deepening and hiding shadows, walls and bursts of darkness, invisibility (I/II/True), a living shadow-familiar that spies, fights, and eventually casts spells for the caster, banishing a shadow, and True Night which snuffs out even magical light. Special notes from the source: shadows are a creation of Light - darkness is merely the absence of Light, created by deflecting or absorbing it; because Darkness is a sub-force of Light, spells that protect against or counter Light also affect Darkness, and creatures immune to Light-based attacks are immune to Dark-based attacks too. Fidelity note: levels 12 and 13 are intentionally blank in the source (no spell printed).
Detects any magically occurring shadows or darkness.
Target can see 100' on a normal night as if it were daylight. See of Essence, section 15.12.
Creates a wall of absolute darkness (up to 10'x10'x1'). This wall prevents all light from passing through its surface; nothing can see through the wall and light-based attacks cannot penetrate.
Frequency and depth of shadows increase for the duration. All stalk and hide attempts in the area are at +20 for the duration.

Target's shadow is no longer visible. This helps prevent detection while invisible giving another -20 modifier to detect through normal means (spells always work). Target gains a special +10 bonus to Stalking and Ambush while this spell is in effect.
Everything within 1' radius of target is invisible as long as it stays within 1' of the original target and none of the termination conditions for the unseen spell occur.
Causes a 10' R burst of intense dark. All those in the area of effect are stunned 1 round per 5% failure.
As Wall of Darkness, except duration is 1 round per level.
As Nightvision, except any darkness can be seen through. Also, no light is needed for this spell to work.

Natural shadows vibrate and change hue for the duration. This will confuse any shadow-based sneaking spell causing any bonuses from the spell to be negated. Also, all within the area are at -20 to Stalking and Hiding attempts.
As Invisibility I, except the radius can vary up to 1' (chosen at the time of casting). This makes the invisible target harder to see.
As Nightvision, except it affects one target per level.

Caster can see the flow of light and discern its various colors and spectrums. By concentrating caster can sift through magical and non-magical light. Illusions can be perceived and invisible creatures are discernable. It also gives a +25 to locate hidden objects.
As Deepen Shadow, except the radius is 100'.
As Sudden Dark I, except the radius is 50'.

Caster can transform his shadow into a shadow spy. A Shadow Spy will follow any moderately simple instructions the caster gives (e.g., follow that man, go to the center of town, look in the next room). It moves at a rate of 100' and cannot move through solid objects (though they can fit through small openings.) They cannot affect any solid object. If the Shadow Spy has not returned at the end of the spell's duration, it will begin traveling at the rate of 500' per round to return to the caster. When the Shadow Spy returns the caster sees everything that the Shadow Spy witnessed. While the caster is "reliving" what the spy saw, he is in a trance-like state. As long as the caster's shadow is spying, he will have no mundane shadow.

As Shadow Spy, except that shadow may interact with the environment and has the following combat statistics: AT4; DB [half the caster's], Hits [half the caster's], Melee Attack [half the caster's best OB]. The shadow warrior can only be affected by magical attacks. If destroyed, the caster takes 50% of his remaining hits and the caster's shadow will not return for 1 week.

As Shadow Servant, except the Shadow also has half of the caster's PP's (the PPs he has remaining after casting this spell). The Shadow can cast spells from any one list that the caster knows (the list is designated when the spell is cast.)

[RR Mod: -10] Target shadow (either a Shadow creature or Shadow Spy, Shadow Servant, or Shadow Mage) is banished to the elemental plane of Light, painfully ripping it from the target's body (if from a spell caster.) Shadow creatures that are banished this way may not return and may be slain (GM discretion.) A shadow from one of the spells on this list will be gone for 1 day per 10% failure. During that time the caster does not have a shadow and may not cast the Shadow Spy, Shadow Servant, or Shadow Mage, spells. Additionally, target loses 25% of their remaining hits and 25% of their remaining power points in addition to other penalties provided by the Shadow spell's description.

Caster creates an area of absolute darkness; all existing light sources are immediately extinguished (even Utterlight.) Any light sources that are introduced after the first round of the spell will not function, except Utterlight, which will have half of its normal radius.
As Invisibility I, except if target attacks, they are visible for one round then they become invisible again.
